title.zh: CrowdCell Campaign 类型脚本 约束

subtitle.zh: 来源：alesfer001/CrowdCell / contracts/campaign/src/main.rs@2fd13f6　·　0x1d9b…659c (data2，仅测试网)　·　社区合约，未经独立审计
subtitle.en: Source: alesfer001/CrowdCell / contracts/campaign/src/main.rs@2fd13f6　·　0x1d9b…659c (data2, testnet only)　·　community contract, not independently audited

outputs.label: campaign
outputs.body:
Cell{ type: { codeHash: CAMPAIGN, args: {{type_id 32B}} ‖ {{pledge_lock_code_hash 32B}} },
  data: creator_lock_hash ‖ {{funding_goal>0}} ‖ {{deadline_block>0}} ‖ {{total_pledged=0}} ‖ {{status=0}} ‖ reserved ‖ metadata }

cond.zh: TypeID 校验失败
长度 ≥ 64 且 pledge_lock_code_hash ≠ 0
group 内输入、输出各至多 1 个
cond.en: at most 1 group input and 1 group output

cond.zh: ≥ 65 字节
status ∈ {0,1,2}
> 0（不检查是否在未来）
cond.en: > 0 (not checked to be in the future)

cond.zh: = 0 Active

inputs.label: campaign
inputs.body: Cell{ capacity: C, data: …total_pledged = T, status = 0 }
Cell{ lock: { codeHash: pledge_lock_code_hash, args: campaign_type_hash ‖ … } }

body.zh: Cell{ {{capacity ≥ C}}, data: {{total_pledged = T + Σnew − Σold}}, status = 0, 其余字段不变 }
body.en: Cell{ {{capacity ≥ C}}, data: {{total_pledged = T + Σnew − Σold}}, status = 0, other fields unchanged }

outputs.label: pledge
outputs.body: Cell{ lock: { codeHash: {{pledge_lock_code_hash}}, args: {{campaign_type_hash}} ‖ deadline ‖ backer_lock_hash }, data(72B)[64..72] = {{amount ≥ 100 CKB}}, {{capacity ≥ amount + occupied}} }

cond.zh: 输出 campaign capacity ≥ 输入
旧状态必须为 Active
creator_lock_hash / funding_goal / deadline_block / 长度 / [57..] 不变
属于本 campaign 的 pledge cell data ≥ 72 字节
cond.en: pledge cell data of this campaign ≥ 72 bytes

cond.zh: 新建 pledge 的 amount ≥ 100 CKB（10,000,000,000 shannon）
pledge capacity ≥ amount + occupied capacity
Σ新建 > Σ消耗，且新 total = 旧 total + 差值
cond.en: Σcreated > Σconsumed, and new total = old total + delta

cond.zh: 累加溢出

body.zh: Cell{ data: status = 0 }, {{since = 绝对区块号 ≥ deadline_block}}
body.en: Cell{ data: status = 0 }, {{since = absolute block ≥ deadline_block}}

body.zh: Cell{ {{capacity ≥ C}}, data: {{total_pledged 不变}}, {{status = total ≥ goal ? 1 : 2}} }
body.en: Cell{ {{capacity ≥ C}}, data: {{total_pledged unchanged}}, {{status = total ≥ goal ? 1 : 2}} }

cond.zh: 输出 capacity ≥ 输入
非 0、绝对、标志合法、按区块号，且 ≥ deadline_block
cond.en: non-zero, absolute, valid flags, block number, ≥ deadline_block

cond.zh: 旧状态 Active；新状态不能是 Active
cond.en: old status Active; new status not Active

cond.zh: 不可变字段与 total_pledged 不变
Success 要求 total ≥ goal；Failed 要求 total < goal
cond.en: Success requires total ≥ goal; Failed requires total < goal

body.zh: Cell{ capacity: C, data: {{status ∈ {1,2}}} }, {{since = 绝对区块号 ≥ deadline + 1,944,000}}
body.en: Cell{ capacity: C, data: {{status ∈ {1,2}}} }, {{since = absolute block ≥ deadline + 1,944,000}}

outputs.body: Σ Cell{ lock hash = creator_lock_hash }.capacity {{≥ C − 1 CKB}}

cond.zh: Active 不可销毁
同一交易中不得花费任何 pledge-lock cell
cond.en: no pledge-lock cell may be spent in the same tx

cond.zh: 付给 creator_lock_hash 的 capacity ≥ C − 1 CKB
cond.en: capacity paid to creator_lock_hash ≥ C − 1 CKB

cond.zh: 非 0、绝对区块号且 ≥ deadline_block + 1,944,000（约 180 天）

notes.zh: 错误码（main.rs）：1 data 过短 · 2 status 非法 · 3 goal=0 · 4 deadline=0 · 5 创建时 total≠0 · 6 创建时非 Active · 7 NO_SCRIPT · 9 LOAD_DATA · 10 INVALID_FINALIZATION · 12 INVALID_TYPE_ID · 13 DESTRUCTION_NOT_ALLOWED · 14 LOAD_SINCE · 15 INVALID_ARGS · 16 INVALID_PLEDGE_UPDATE · 17 CAPACITY_DECREASED · 18 STATUS_NOT_JUSTIFIED · 19 OVERFLOW · 20 LOAD_CELL · 21 MULTIPLE_CAMPAIGN_CELLS · 22 PLEDGE_UNDERFUNDED · 23 PLEDGE_BELOW_MINIMUM · 24 CREATOR_NOT_PAID · 25 DESTRUCTION_WITH_PLEDGES（11 MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED 已定义但未使用）
notes.en: Error codes (main.rs): 1 data too short · 2 bad status · 3 goal=0 · 4 deadline=0 · 5 total≠0 at creation · 6 not Active at creation · 7 NO_SCRIPT · 9 LOAD_DATA · 10 INVALID_FINALIZATION · 12 INVALID_TYPE_ID · 13 DESTRUCTION_NOT_ALLOWED · 14 LOAD_SINCE · 15 INVALID_ARGS · 16 INVALID_PLEDGE_UPDATE · 17 CAPACITY_DECREASED · 18 STATUS_NOT_JUSTIFIED · 19 OVERFLOW · 20 LOAD_CELL · 21 MULTIPLE_CAMPAIGN_CELLS · 22 PLEDGE_UNDERFUNDED · 23 PLEDGE_BELOW_MINIMUM · 24 CREATOR_NOT_PAID · 25 DESTRUCTION_WITH_PLEDGES (11 MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED is defined but unused)

notes.zh: pledge 归属判定用 pledge cell 的 lock（code_hash = args[32..64] 且 lock args[0..32] = 本 campaign type hash），pledge data 里的 campaign_id 仅作信息
notes.en: A pledge belongs to the campaign by its lock (code_hash = args[32..64] and lock args[0..32] = this campaign's type hash); campaign_id in pledge data is informational

notes.zh: 谁能花费 campaign cell（以及截止前能否结算）由 campaign-lock 决定，本页不覆盖；pledge cell 自身的 type 规则见 CrowdCell 的 pledge 类型脚本（未收录）
notes.en: Who may spend the campaign cell is decided by campaign-lock (not covered here); pledge cells' own type rules live in CrowdCell's pledge type script (not included)

notes.zh: 非本合约规则：README 的 ~180 天按 8 秒/块估算
notes.en: Not a contract rule: the README's ~180 days assumes 8 s blocks

notes.zh: CrowdCell 自述为测试网预览，合约已由 CKB 开发者审阅但未经独立审计
notes.en: CrowdCell describes itself as a testnet preview; contracts reviewed by CKB developers but not independently audited
